execution: Unexecuted source and failure-injection cases; static inspection only.

cases.input: base, medium and full desktop roles
cases.expect: The same nine desktop field components and toolkit/icon/pointer controls are present; application-preference pages are absent.

cases.input: Waybar module, stylesheet and symbolic-icon edits, plus Swaylock edits
cases.expect: Exact owner write authority covers the native file, its directory and its private .managed-* sibling; no broader application directory is writable.

cases.input: Render all 567 field defaults and retain 672 source mappings
cases.expect: All mappings still identify the current source line, token index and native grammar; no unresolved target path enters installed data.

cases.input: Replace a setup module with a symlink, hardlink, wrong owner or permissive mode
cases.expect: The private import boundary rejects the candidate before importing it; no installed setup wrapper remains.

cases.input: Digest mismatch, truncated gzip, excessive expanded bytes, excessive members, duplicate path or escaped member
cases.expect: Extraction fails before public theme publication; only private retained input data may remain. No archive executable runs.

cases.input: Outer pinned theme release containing symlink, hardlink, device or FIFO members
cases.expect: Outer member validation refuses the archive. Narrow contained-link handling inside approved vendor theme archives stays separate.

cases.input: Lose the acknowledgment after a public theme directory rename
cases.expect: Return outcome-unknown with the private publication journal and identities retained; do not automatically retry or delete evidence.

cases.input: Fail owned-stage cleanup after the theme inventory commit
cases.expect: Keep the committed inventory and return a distinct cleanup-pending status; retain recovery data.

cases.input: Run a second color or theme writer while the shared account lock is held
cases.expect: Reject the second writer without changing native files; cleanup and recovery retain the same ownership lock.

cases.input: Interrupt between native file publication and journal commit
cases.expect: Recover exact previous bytes or retain the journal if recovery cannot be proved; never report success on an uncertain result.

cases.input: Interrupt a dock color edit immediately before or after its service stop, before publishing native files
cases.expect: The same account lock owns the operation. A durable journal records prior liveness before the stop; recovery starts the previously active dock without reverting legitimate QSettings shutdown writes.

cases.input: Select both user desktop colors and greeter colors, then cancel or fail administrator authentication
cases.expect: Restore the user's previous native bytes and dock liveness. Keep the account journal until authenticated greeter rollback is proved; do not report a partially saved selection as success.

cases.input: Lose the pkexec reply after the root greeter files were written, before the account commit decision
cases.expect: The root-owned journal binds the initiating UID and transaction token. Account recovery requests rollback through the existing authenticated helper; unrelated callers or tokens cannot finalize it.

cases.input: Interrupt after the account commit decision and before root finalization or dock restart
cases.expect: Verify committed account bytes, finalize the matching root journal and restore prior dock liveness before clearing account recovery evidence. No automatic replay of the requested mutation occurs.

cases.input: The dock start job returns but the exact user unit is not active, or its status cannot be established
cases.expect: Keep the committed account journal and report unfinished recovery; never clear liveness evidence merely because the start request returned zero.

cases.input: Replace a committed theme or color file before recovery finalizes its root journal
cases.expect: Retain both journals and return a conflict before root finalization; never erase recovery evidence or overwrite the concurrent file.

cases.input: A fields-pending.json recovery file is retained when a new greeter field, theme or wallpaper edit is requested
cases.expect: Refuse the new root mutation without interpreting, replaying, rewriting or deleting that file. New transactions write only the shared pending.json journal; explicit recovery must resolve the retained evidence first.

cases.input: Custom CA enabled and SYSTEM_NAMESERVERS_TLS_SAN_CUSTOM empty
cases.expect: Each configured resolver keeps its authenticated hostname; no wildcard, empty peer name, insecure TLS mode or CA fallback is introduced.
